tools.add_question: Add a question of your own to the trivia bank, for the game page and for chat. A category that is not on the list becomes a new category.
tools.remove_question: Remove a question you added to the trivia bank.

packages.name: Weather
packages.description: The weather where you live: right now, a forecast for up to 7 days, and severe weather alerts in the United States. It asks free public weather services, with no account or key. It does not read Home Assistant sensors, give air quality or pollen, or check alerts outside the United States.
packages.author: Cypher Sisters

tools.set_location: Save the place to give weather for: a town name, or coordinates like 40.71,-74.01, and the temperature unit. A town name is looked up once to get its coordinates.
tools.current_weather: The weather right now at the saved place: temperature, sky, feels-like, humidity and wind.
tools.forecast: The forecast at the saved place for today and the next days: sky, high and low, and the chance of rain or snow.
tools.severe_alerts: Active severe weather alerts (storms, floods, heat advisories) at the saved place, from the US National Weather Service. Outside the United States there are none to check.

set_location: set my weather location to Asheville, North Carolina
current_weather: what's the weather like right now
forecast: what's the forecast for the next five days
severe_alerts: are there any severe weather alerts

packages.name: Web search
packages.description: Searches the web through a SearXNG you run yourself, on this computer or your home network: web results and news, the top 8 each, with the title, a one-line snippet, the address and the engine that found it. It does not use a public SearXNG or ask any search company directly, does not search images, does not open or read the pages it finds, and does not install or run SearXNG for you.
packages.author: Cypher Sisters

tools.web_search: Search the web through the owner's own SearXNG and get the top 8 results: the title, a one-line snippet, the address and the engine that found it. Good for news, prices, opening hours and anything that changes.
tools.news_search: Search recent news through the owner's own SearXNG and get the top 8 stories: the title, a one-line snippet, the address and the engine that found it.
tools.search_settings: Which SearXNG address web search uses, and whether it answers right now.
tools.set_address: Save the address of the owner's own SearXNG, like http://192.168.1.20:8888 or http://127.0.0.1:8888. Only an address on this computer or the home network is taken; a public SearXNG is refused. For an address off this computer, the bot raises a Yes card for that address and port.

look up what time the hardware store on Main Street closes
news_search: what's in the news about the Mars mission
search the news for storm damage in our county
search_settings: which search box does web search use
